entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, whatever. I need to make a return.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit support. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
The name is Mark Peterson. Order number is... VF77-B10-9-PULSE. It's for that VeloBand Pulse monitor.

Thank you, Mark. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 27th. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's no 'issue'. I just **changed my mind**, alright? It was an **impulse buy** for the new year and I just **don't use it**.
I see. So the device is working correctly, but it's just not the right fit for your routine?
Look, are you going to process the return or just ask me a million questions? I want my money back. It's that simple. I'm getting really tired of this runaround.
I understand your frustration, sir. I just need to verify the return eligibility based on our policies. Please allow me one moment.

This is unbelievable! I've had it less than a month! If you can't authorize a simple return, I demand to speak to your manager right now. I will plaster bad reviews about VeloFit all over the internet. This is horrible service!
That won't be necessary, Mark. I'm checking the policy right now... Okay, I've got it. It looks like you're all set.

Yes, our internal VeloFit policy states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it on December 27th, you are well within that timeframe. I can process that full refund for you immediately.
Oh. Ninety days? It's that long? Okay... well... good. Yes, do that. Process the return.

Of course. I'm generating your pre-paid return shipping label now and sending it to the email we have on file. Simply print it, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off at your local post office. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see the refund back on your card in 3 to 5 business days.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Mark. Have a good day.
